name: 27021 · King, NC
findings: ZIP 27021 (King) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (67% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27021 (King) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 27021 (King) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 36% of the typical level).
